about: What scripts/check-publish.mjs allows (public-release O1.2). Every entry has a reason.
constants: public protocol addresses, event topics and hash vectors.
thirdParty: addresses and hashes from public on-chain activity that have nothing to do with the operator, used as test references.
files: files reviewed as a whole and pinned by sha256 (line endings ignored). A change fails the check until someone reviews it again and updates the hash.
lines: lines the personal-data rules would stop, reviewed as harmless. They never excuse a denylist entry.
Nothing of the operator's belongs here in any form: that is the denylist's job, and it lives outside the repository.
